caption:
You’re not anxious because something is wrong You’re anxious because your mind left the present 

#usahealth #healthybodyhealthymind #wellnessjourney #wellness #anxiety
transcript: You're not anxious because something is wrong. You're anxious because your mind left the present. Anxiety is not mysterious. It's simply the mind stepping into the future and sounding an alarm in the body. Nothing is actually happening yet. But the body responds as if it already is. When you catch yourself worrying, when you notice the mind jumping ahead, what if this, what if that? Understand this. Thoughts, when left alone, will keep spinning. And the body will follow. So you interrupt the pattern. Five, four, three, two, one. You bring yourself back to this moment. Then you gently place a new thought into the mind. What if it all works out? Just that. What if it all works out? What if the plane is bumpy and still lands safely? What if the thing you fear passes quietly? The mind cannot argue with this. And when the mind settles, the body settles, the alarm quiets, you can also remind yourself, this moment will pass. I can handle this, but you must intervene. You don't fight the thought. You don't judge it. You simply replace it. And in that space, calm returns. And if you want support practicing this each day, I created a 30-day healing journey. It's in my profile if you feel called.
